public_rationale: The cited post reports uneven performance across tasks, but that does not establish uneven returns to extra inference compute. Its cross-model evaluations generally use o1 at maximum test-time compute. The located evidence does not settle the claim as written. Reading it simply as a claim about uneven o1-versus-GPT-4o performance would change the assessment.
limitations: The conclusion depends on distinguishing model comparisons from compute-scaling experiments.
Missing negative compute sweeps are an evidence gap, not proof that every task benefits.
